description: This file defines the ReadableOrderTotal class, which extends OrderTotal and implements Serializable. It adds a 'total' property with getter and setter methods, serving as a data transfer object likely used for presenting order total information.

classes.name: ReadableOrderTotal
classes.description: A class that extends OrderTotal and implements Serializable, providing a readable representation of the order total with an additional 'total' property.
